The '''Shrine of Judgment''' was one of the ancient [[Voss (species)|Voss]] temples located near the [[Interpreter's Retreat]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]].

==History==
Like the two other shrines located in the area, the [[Shrine of Contemplation]] and the [[Shrine of Silence]], the Shrine of Judgment sustained heavy damage during the [[Invasion of Voss]] by the [[Eternal Empire]]. After the war, the Voss and [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] created the [[Shrine Restoration Initiative]] as a joint effort to restore the damaged shrines.<ref name="TOR:OW">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Old Wounds|Voss}}</ref>

Around [[3624 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|7.3}}</ref> the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] involved in the restoration project became dysfunctional and attacked the Gormak workers in the Shrine of Judgment. [[Makiff]] and his men were eventually rescued by [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]].<ref name="TOR:WA" />

Some time after the Shrine of Judgment was secured, the droid [[EX-V8]] was tasked with audio tours of the temple. The Alliance Commander later returned to the Shrine of Judgment and was introduced to the [[Parable of Judgment]] during the visit.<ref name="TOR:EJ">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Exercising Judgment|Voss}}</ref>
